title: PowerPoint on the web: reference an existing PowerPoint file when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licence-management instructions and sensitivity-label inheritance statement are supported. No blocking inaccuracies were found; the sharing review in the governance checklist is not represented in the controls table.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: New content created with Copilot in PowerPoint from a sensitivity-labelled source automatically inherits its label and protection settings.
claims.quote: If you use Copilot in Word, Copilot in PowerPoint, and Copilot in Outlook to create new content based on an item that has a sensitivity label applied, the sensitivity label from the source file is automatically inherited, with the label's protection settings.

claims.where: controls[0].ui
claims.claim: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses reaches user licence assignment.
claims.quote: Go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign, then select Save changes.

claims.where: controls[0].api
claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses containing SkuId, and an empty RemoveLicenses array assigns the selected licence.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.where: Governance controls: required admin role
claims.claim: Assigning licences requires an administrator role documented on the linked licence page.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.where: Governance controls: release-note setting absence; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint reference existing deck feature 555892 default rollout admin switch; PowerPoint Agent Mode admin setting. Read the July 01 entry and wordexcelppt-agents; the latter's Anthropic controls concern separate agents in the Copilot app, not this reference-file option.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The table's licence operation assigns the user's product licence rather than switching this individual option.
claims.quote: When you use the Active users page to assign or unassign licenses, you assign or unassign users licenses to products.

claims.where: Governance controls: source-deck permissions; Governance guidance: sharing review
claims.claim: Source-file permissions are an applicable way to govern which decks Copilot can read for a user.
claims.quote: This capability respects existing file permissions and access controls.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist's source-deck sharing review has a corresponding control row.
claims.quote: Review sharing on decks that users are likely to reference, such as shared templates and board packs. / The only control in the table is the Copilot licence.
claims.fix: The Before rollout step 'Review sharing on decks that users are likely to reference' has no corresponding row in the controls table. Treat it as general review advice, not a documented table control; no new control row is requested.
